name: Ventriloc
mood: Editorial data observatory on warm paper, with monochrome precision, flat data cards, asymmetric surfaces, and a single orange ember accent.

graphite.role: Primary text, headings, nav links, icon strokes, and button fills.

canvasWhite.role: Page background, bright cards, and icon fills.

ash.role: Primary card and section background, plus nav pill containers.

ivory.role: Warm accent background wash for featured editorial blocks.

steel.role: Secondary body text and long-form paragraphs.

slate.role: Helper text, tertiary nav, inactive controls, and footer utility text.

mist.role: Hairline dividers and subtle nav fills.

emberOrange.role: Link underline, chart highlight, tag accent, and small icon accent.

brass.role: Muted warm secondary accent for chart strokes, decorative data lines, and captions.

families.polysansFallback: Inter Tight, Space Grotesk, ui-sans-serif, system-ui

rules: Use PolySans-style text at weight 400 only.
Use -0.02em tracking on every PolySans-style element.
Use Inter for body, captions, metadata, helper text, and UI labels.

ivorySurface.role: Warm accent wash for editorial blocks.

rules: Use surface contrast, whitespace, and geometry for depth.
Keep data cards and nav pills flat.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.recipe: Graphite fill, Canvas White text, 0px radius, PolySans-style 16px weight 400, -0.02em tracking, 10px 20px padding, no shadow.

components.name: Ghost Outlined Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Graphite border, Graphite text, 0px radius, 10px 20px padding, PolySans-style 16px weight 400.

components.name: Navigation Pill Container
components.recipe: Ash background, 200px radius, 8px vertical and 18px horizontal padding, PolySans-style 16px links inside.

components.name: Asymmetric Radius Card
components.recipe: Ash background, radius 6px 0px 0px, generous padding, no border, no shadow.

components.name: Data Dashboard Card
components.recipe: Canvas White surface, 20px radius, 40px padding, chart accents in Ember Orange and Brass, no shadow.

components.name: Link With Orange Underline
components.recipe: Base text color with 1px Ember Orange underline offset 2-3px below baseline.

do: Use PolySans-style headings at weight 400 only.
Use Ember Orange only for punctuation.
Use square buttons, asymmetric featured cards, and pill navigation.
Use 20px element gaps and 80px section gaps.
Alternate Canvas White and Ash section bands.
Use chart widgets as the primary imagery.
dont: Do not use Ember Orange as a filled button background.
Do not add shadows to cards or buttons.
Do not make all cards symmetrically rounded.
Do not add extra accent colors.

imagery.style: Data-driven charts, stat cards, rings, and monochrome partner logos.
rules: Use Ember Orange and Brass for thin chart strokes only.
Avoid lifestyle photography and decorative hero illustrations.
Treat charts as the visual content.

layout.hero: Two-column split with headline and CTAs left, overlapping data cards right.
layout.sections: Alternating Canvas White and Ash bands with 80px gaps.
layout.nav: Floating pill container centered in the header, brand left, dark contact button right.
layout.rhythm: Wide margins, tall sections, report-like cards, and sparse orange punctuation.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
